content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHAI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHAI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application submission is 18th September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by NHAI?
faq.answer: NHAI has announced a total of 12 vacancies for the posts of General Manager and Deputy General Manager.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the General Manager (Law) post?
faq.answer: For the General Manager (Law) post, candidates need a Bachelor of Law degree along with 14 years of experience, including 6 years in contractual matters, arbitration, or land acquisition.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for NHAI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the NHAI posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 56 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Deputy General Manager (Information Technology) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Deputy General Manager (Information Technology) post is Level-12, which ranges from Rs. 78800 to Rs. 209200 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for NHAI recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for NHAI recruitment is strictly online through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these NHAI posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Deputation, Document Verification, and Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Does NHAI offer any age relaxation?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for further information.
